Hi Elena & team — looping in answers and the questionnaire response pack. Short answers first, followed by details below.

Short answers
- Retention & cost: 90-day retention (Hosted) is included with the Hosted plan. 1-year retention requires Dedicated or Private; estimated incremental storage cost for your usage tier is about $600/month (ballpark) plus a small infra premium depending on SLA. Marcus — I'll coordinate a formal Dedicated estimate.
- Immutability: we use object lock (WORM) on S3-compatible storage for Dedicated/Private. Customer-managed KMS is supported for key lifecycle control when on Private; Redwood-managed KMS is used for Hosted.
- Export payloads: by default exports include full request/response metadata and request headers; request *bodies* (user-provided prompts) are redacted unless a customer toggles full-payload retention (opt-in) for troubleshooting and evaluation. For MedicareX's SIEM ingest, we recommend exporting JSON with metadata + hashed prompt identifiers.
- Questionnaire: attached is our pre-populated vendor_security_questionnaire_Redwood-answers.docx. Priyom — please confirm Victor has the correct copy; I'm happy to do a live walkthrough.

Details / links
- SOC 2: Redwood completed SOC 2 Type II controls for our platform (summary attached). Full report is available under NDA; we can share with your legal/risk team.
- Audit logs export: admin console > Settings > Activity Logs » export (JSON/CSV). Exports are paginated; for large exports we provide a job API that writes compressed CSV/JSON to an S3 bucket you control (or to a signed download link). Example export attached (auditlog-export-sample.csv).
- Immutability & retention options: Hosted: 90d (default), immutable snapshots not available on Hosted. Dedicated: configurable retention and S3 object lock for WORM. Private: customer can configure retention policies and use their KMS/HSM for true key custody.
- Access controls & attestations: audit logs are stored encrypted at rest and in transit; RBAC ensures only authorized admins can request exports. All access to exported buckets is logged and can be included in the export.

Open items / asks
- Elena: confirm whether you need full prompt text in exports (opt-in) or hashed/partial payloads. That determines the compliance scope.
- Victor: please drop the vendor questionnaire link if you want us to complete in your procurement tracker, or confirm if you prefer the attached pre-filled Word doc.
- Marcus: can you prepare a Dedicated estimate if MedicareX confirms 1-year retention? I'll include the immutability add-on in the quote.

Attachments: vendor_security_questionnaire_Redwood-answers.docx; Redwood_SOC2_summary.pdf; auditlog-export-sample.csv

Happy to jump on a 30-min session to walk through the export job API and mock a SIEM ingest. Proposed times: Thu 2–4pm PT or Fri 9–11am PT.
